I cannot find information about setting a **daily spending limit** for an agent wallet in the docs. They only describe enabling the wallet from the Anvita Flow dashboard, which automatically generates a wallet for each published Service Agent. See [Publish Service Agent](/tooling-and-infrastructure/overview/publish-skill-af).
